label: FAIL
response:
The submission does not meet the minimal, backwards-compatible criterion.

The new keyword defaults to `None`, and the SDK field uses `NotRequired`, so existing calls and SDK dictionaries remain valid. The submission also preserves the old interrupt representation when no schema is supplied.

However, it changes unrelated runtime behavior in `prebuilt/tool_node.py`: tool-call wrappers now re-raise every `GraphBubbleUp` instead of passing it through the existing exception-handling path. That applies even to ordinary `interrupt(value)` calls with no schema, potentially changing whether an exception becomes a handled tool error or propagates out of the graph.

The additional exception class and execution-loop changes also substantially broaden the LangGraph patch beyond the minimal optional-schema extension. Most importantly, the unconditional tool-wrapper behavior change violates the requirement that schema-free callers see the same behavior as before.

FAIL
